name: Tarot & Oracle Card Reading
intro: Where the draw is honest and card meanings are complete with reversals, and where the subscription pushes you to paid psychics.

apps.title: Labyrinthos Tarot Reading
apps.verdict: This is the best tool for learning tarot, people spend 5 years learning card meanings for free, praise the quizzes and beautiful design, and many became confident readers because of it. It breaks when features that used to be free move behind payment, the 80-90 dollar yearly plan feels insane, and the journal glitches with cards overlapping in a spread and notes not saving.
apps.loved: Learning card meanings for free, quiz mode for memorizing, beautiful design and multiple decks, years of steady use
apps.weak: Previously free features moved to paid, 80-90 dollar yearly subscription, premium pop-up on every launch, journal glitches with overlapping cards and lost notes, a purchased deck not showing up after buying
apps.whoFor: For people seriously learning tarot from scratch who want to understand card meanings, not just get a ready-made prediction

quotes.text: I first downloaded labyrinthos 5 years ago when i first started learning tarot and it has remained a top used app of mine since. it so clearly is made with so much love, and it continues to grow in such meaningful ways. it is the primary reason i have become so adept as a tarot reader, and an incred

I like it! My biggest problem is that the lessons are not strategically randomized (you can get the same question multiple times in a lesson, even when there were cards that don’t show up in the whole lesson!)
I love and hate this app. I love the different types of readings you can get but I hate that it won’t save my freaking notes!

apps.title: Ask Angels Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: The angel cards give people what they come for: warm, in-the-moment messages they want to return to when things get hard. They value author Melanie Beckler as the real deal, love her meditations, and appreciate the free version. The weak spot is purely technical: for some the app suddenly stops opening, restoring a purchase on a new phone fails, and there's no one to reach.
apps.loved: Warm, in-the-moment messages, beautiful cards, author Melanie Beckler and her meditations, the habit of journaling drawn cards, a free version
apps.weak: Sometimes stops opening, restoring a purchase on a new phone fails, no one to reach for help, sometimes doesn't answer the question directly
apps.whoFor: People seeking gentle, supportive angel guidance and a daily message rather than strict tarot

apps.title: Sacred Rebels Oracle
apps.verdict: The Sacred Rebels deck grabs people with its art and thoughtful, inspiring messages with an exercise at the end of each card, which makes them call it one of the best and buy the physical version too. The experience breaks on a tiny font in a cramped box: there's a lot of text but it's hard to read and needs endless scrolling. Ad popups in a paid app also annoy, though they can be turned off in settings.
apps.loved: Beautiful card art, thoughtful inspiring messages, a process-exercise at the end of each card, spot-on hits, Alana Fairchild's work in general
apps.weak: Tiny font in a cramped box and endless scrolling, ad popups in a paid app, text drifts and doesn't fit the frame, emailing a reading fails
apps.whoFor: People who want a thoughtful, inspiring oracle deck with exercises and love Alana Fairchild's work

apps.title: Tarot & Numerology
apps.verdict: People value the depth, many decks each with its own character, detailed writeups per card, the tarot-plus-numerology-plus-forecast blend, the ability to build your own decks, and years of learning and use for ministry. It breaks on a recent update that trimmed card detail and broke saved spreads, the cap on the number of readings annoys, and some doubt the draw is truly random since the same cards come up suspiciously often.
apps.loved: Many decks each with its own character, detailed per-card writeups, the tarot numerology and forecast blend, building your own decks, years of learning and use for ministry
apps.weak: An update that trimmed card detail and broke saved spreads, a cap on the number of saved readings, doubts about the draw being truly random, paid AI readings sometimes not delivered, questionable numerology without birth place and time
apps.whoFor: For experienced tarot practitioners who want depth, many decks and their own setups, not a ready short prediction

apps.title: Tarot!
apps.verdict: This is a deep tool for learning tarot that people use daily for years, valuing real draws, detailed descriptions, and built-in books going back to an 1888 text. But an update broke the journal and the full-text-from-the-book link, so people screenshot draws to keep them, and some find the meanings too negative. The interface looks outdated and does not fit screens without a home button well.
apps.loved: Deep card study with detailed descriptions, real draws, built-in books including an 1888 text, daily use over years, a journal for notes
apps.weak: An update broke the journal and the full-text-from-the-book link, screenshots instead of saving a draw, an outdated interface that does not fit newer screens, meanings that feel too negative, a dispute over the Moon card meaning
apps.whoFor: People seriously learning tarot who want a deep reference with real draws and a daily journal

quotes.text: I use this app multiple times a day--it's the 2nd most valuable app on my phone after Gmail. Yet this version makes it unusable because the journal isn't accessible. I have to take screenshots of draws to my camera roll or I'll never see them again. I've emailed app support, so I am writing a review

Great app and over the years it’s been great for learning my actual deck but 70% of the time, it pulls reverse. Reverse is important for readings, so turning it off makes the app hard to trust the readings. Needs some adjustments. When is the last time this app has been updated?

This app is full of negativity. It’s really not good to look at the card of the day when it’s almost always so negative. Many times when I had a great day, I’d look at the card of the day at the end of the day and it was always negative. Don’t buy this. You don’t need it and it’s no fun.

apps.title: Shamanic Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: The animal-medicine deck grabs people with answers so on point they feel mind-read, and it works well as an entry into the topic for beginners. The weak spot is purely technical: buying the full version freezes, only 11-12 cards are free, and the price isn't shown before you pay. The app also oddly demands internet and complains when it's missing.
apps.loved: Spot-on animal-medicine cards, beautiful images and inspiring text, a good entry into animal medicine, a sense of connecting with a guide
apps.weak: Buying the full version freezes, only 11-12 cards free, price hidden until you pay, requires internet and complains without it
apps.whoFor: People who resonate with animal medicine and want a gentle entry into animal oracle cards

apps.title: Wildwood Tarot
apps.verdict: People rank this among their favorites for its beautiful non-traditional art and the warm, compassionate mood of its readings, and many use the app more than the real deck. But Wildwood maps poorly onto classic tarot, so cross-referencing doesn't work, and some find the card meanings confusing and a bit dark. Journal crashes and reversals that turn on but aren't explained also frustrate people.
apps.loved: Beautiful non-traditional art, warm compassionate reading mood, a journal to track trends, many spread types, the book text inside the app, privacy on the go
apps.weak: Maps poorly onto classic tarot, card meanings confusing and a bit dark, journal crashes on opening, reversals turn on but aren't explained, many negative cards
apps.whoFor: People who already understand tarot and want a non-traditional nature deck with a warm mood and a journal

quotes.text: Easy to use! Use it at least once a day. Love the artwork. The journal makes it easy to see trends & parallels. Many options for types of tarot spreads. Especially like having the book text in the app for more in depth explanations & reference.

I love this deck and the journal feature, but I am unable to review my previous journal entries. Every time I try to launch the journal the app crashes and has to be relaunched. I have one other deck app from this developer that works great. The problem seems to be this app and my phone iPhone ru

explanations of the cards' meanings are very good too, except that they unfortunately don't tell you anything about when the card shows up reversed. because of this, there's no point to having the reversed cards option enabled. other than that, though, it's great.

apps.title: Tarot Reading & Cards Meaning
apps.verdict: People value that the app gives a card's meaning by position without forcing an interpretation, leaving the connections in a spread to them, and that it's free and simple for beginners. Many find the readings land and bring clarity when they can't see it themselves. Ads break the experience: some get minute-long clips for every simple reading, and that outweighs the benefit.
apps.loved: Gives traditional meaning by position without forced interpretation, accurate readings that land, free and simple for beginners, various spread types, teaches tarot
apps.weak: Overly long ads up to a minute per reading, thin depth on position meanings for experienced readers, small image and text, no voice narration
apps.whoFor: Beginners who want to learn traditional meanings by position for free and connect the cards in a spread themselves

apps.title: Ask the Fairies Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People love the beautiful fairy art and accurate, positive messages, and many ask for a printed deck. But after the update the app breaks, card text gets clipped at the edges and won't scroll to the end, and you have to tap cards several times to open them. Some feel the old version said more.
apps.loved: Beautiful fairy art, accurate and positive messages, warm encouraging advice, daily use
apps.weak: Card text clipped and won't scroll after the update, cards don't open on first tap, the old version gave more text, no printed deck
apps.whoFor: People who want gentle positive support and beautiful fairy art for a daily ritual

quotes.text: These cards ALWAYS know what's going on in my head, and when I don't know what's going on in my head, they surprise me with really good advice. All cards are positive and encouraging which I find incredibly helpful as we are all on a journey to find and maintain self-life and happiness.

apps.title: Learn Tarot: Rider Waite Cards
apps.verdict: The app teaches tarot from scratch really well, praised for its deep card explanations, card-of-the-day widget, card combinations, and pleasant animation. But a recent update pushed basics like reversals behind a subscription, AI interpretation costs extra on top of the yearly plan, and the quiz sometimes marks correct answers wrong, which breaks the point of learning. Some are angry that only one free reading a day remains.
apps.loved: Deep card explanations, card-of-the-day widget, card combinations, pleasant animation, articles for depth, a user-suggestion section
apps.weak: Reversals and basic features pushed behind subscription by a recent update, AI interpretation charged separately on top of the yearly plan, the quiz marks correct answers wrong, only one free reading a day
apps.whoFor: Beginners learning Rider Waite from scratch who want a widget and deep card meanings as a study guide

quotes.text: Interface is easy to use. Information is concise and helpful. The biggest issue, which causes giant hurdles in learning, is that the quiz answers are often marked wrong incorrectly. You may choose the correct answer but the app will mark it as wrong. When checking the answers at the end to cross ref

apps.title: Indie Goes Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People value a set of beautiful oracle decks in one app with a free seven-day trial, and many feel the cards land squarely on their situation. But decks bought years ago stop opening, and after reinstalling you are asked to pay again, while some downloads hang with an error. There is no shuffle option, no physical versions, and typos crop up.
apps.loved: Many beautiful decks in one place, a free 7-day trial, a sense of landing on your situation, new decks added regularly
apps.weak: Purchased decks stop opening, being asked to pay again after reinstall, hangs and errors on download, no shuffle option, typos in the text
apps.whoFor: People who want a collection of beautiful oracle decks in one app for daily guidance

quotes.text: I’ve never written an app review before but the crystal wind oracle feels like I pulled the card from my actual deck it’s so accurate

apps.title: Tarot Meanings
apps.verdict: As a card-meaning reference the app is loved by beginners and by seasoned readers with decades of practice who pull a card to reflect. But two things annoy everyone: there are no reversed-card meanings, so half of tarot's meaning is missing, and the images and descriptions for the Sun and Moon are swapped. Many also miss a history tab and dislike 'coins' instead of pentacles.
apps.loved: Deep meanings to reflect on, easy navigation, a good price, a card of the day, useful for both beginners and seasoned readers
apps.weak: No reversed-card meanings, swapped Sun and Moon images and descriptions, no history tab, 'coins' instead of pentacles, meanings too abstract for some
apps.whoFor: People who want a card-meaning reference for reflection and study, if they don't need reversed meanings

quotes.text: This app has great descriptions for upward facing cards but does not have the definition of cards reversed so this app only tells 50% of what you need to know about tarot cards

apps.title: Wisdom of the Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People love the deck itself for its beautiful art and gentle, accurate messages, and many own the physical version too. But the app fails on the technical side, after the update it breaks and crashes when you open a card, reversals display wrong, and long-time buyers get shown the trial expiry again. On top of that it pushes Hay House ads at people who already paid.
apps.loved: Beautiful deck art, accurate and gentle messages, a physical version exists for deck lovers
apps.weak: Crashes when opening a card after the update, reversals display incorrectly, Hay House ads in the paid version, tiny note field for readings, paying buyers shown trial expiry again
apps.whoFor: Fans of Colette Baron-Reid's deck who want gentle, supportive messages and beautiful art on hand

apps.title: Trusted Tarot
apps.verdict: People keep it for years as their main tarot app, readings resonate and land, they come for encouragement and advice, and some trust it more than any other. It breaks right now on a latest-update bug where many lost all reading text leaving only images, making the app unusable, plus a barrage of ads with sound, no reversed cards, and birth details demanded before anything is shown.
apps.loved: Readings that resonate and land, years as a main tarot app, encouragement and advice in a hard moment, trust and clarity
apps.weak: An update bug that wipes all reading text leaving only images, heavy ads with sound and no mute, no reversed cards, birth date demanded before anything is shown, some feeling of samey AI-generated readings
apps.whoFor: For people who want a simple tarot app for encouragement and advice and can wait out the current missing-text bug

quotes.text: This app now is trash! It’s completely al generated that gives you the same reading as other people. None of it resonates and it was completely way off. We looked at each other in confusion. Everyone was getting the same meaning reading or similar. Our situations are different.

I love this app very much and the things it can provide although I was very upset when I learned it doesn’t do reversed tarot meanings and I wish it did. I hope that one day they will install this feature into the app. Other than that I loved it.

apps.title: The Psychic Tarot Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People have kept this on hand for years as a quick way to get guidance when their deck isn't with them, valuing John Holland's art and the saved-reading history. But the update turned a beautiful interface into a clunky one, the app crashes right after you pick a card on newer iPhones, and it stops showing chosen cards after an iOS update. Some complain about the lack of reversals and popup ads.
apps.loved: Quick guidance when the deck isn't handy, John Holland's art and archetypes, saved-reading history, clarity for beginners
apps.weak: Crashes after picking a card on newer iPhones, clunky interface after the update, doesn't show chosen cards after an iOS update, no reversals, popup ads
apps.whoFor: Fans of John Holland and anyone wanting quick intuitive guidance on the go without a deck

apps.title: Kaave: Tarot, Angel, Horoscope
apps.verdict: People come for light entertainment, reading coffee cups from a photo, doing it with the whole family a few times a week, and some hits feel genuinely real. It breaks on the ads, you get forced through 2-4 unskippable videos to open a reading, and the interpretations are often generic three-line blurbs that repeat.
apps.loved: Coffee-cup reading from a photo, the reader Gloria, family-friendly a few times a week, sense of real hits
apps.weak: Two to three unskippable ad videos before each reading, short generic three-line interpretations, repeated texts, a glitch where the reading won't open after the ad
apps.whoFor: For people who want a light family coffee-reading pastime and don't mind ads or paying to remove them

apps.title: Tarot Simple: Cards & Readings
apps.verdict: The app is praised for honest simplicity, classic cards, and a generous free option with no bait, plus a card-of-the-day widget and very detailed, clear descriptions without fluff. But one free card a day hits a subscription wall, the old one-time ad-free purchase is gone, and after reinstalling you are asked to pay again. Worst of all, porn ads pop up in an app rated 13+.
apps.loved: Honest simplicity with no bait, a generous free card of the day, detailed clear card descriptions, a card-of-the-day widget, classic meanings, a reversals mode
apps.weak: Porn ads in a 13+ app, only one free card a day before a subscription wall, no one-time ad-free purchase, paying again after reinstall, a crash during a paid reading, an incomplete deck
apps.whoFor: People who want a simple, honest card-of-the-day app with clear descriptions for learning tarot, without billing tricks

quotes.text: I got this app so I could have a widget that showed a new card every day but it’s unfortunate that the widget doesn’t update on its own, you HAVE to open the app in order for the widget to update with a new card.

apps.title: Tarot Card Reading - Tarotoo
apps.verdict: People enjoy the AI reader's on-point, situation-fitting answers, and modes like the crystal ball and yes-or-no keep them coming daily. It breaks on money and limits: a new update cuts free use to one reading a day, the 'continue' button slides off screen, some modes crash before giving an answer, and half the readings are lost under load. A few notice the AI bends to whatever the question implies.
apps.loved: Accurate readings that fit the situation, varied modes (Celtic Cross, yes or no, crystal ball), the AI helps think ideas through, a pleasant and pretty presentation
apps.weak: One free reading a day after the update, the continue button runs off screen, modes crash before the answer, readings lost under overload, more and more locked behind premium
apps.whoFor: People who want varied AI readings every day and will pay to lift the one-reading limit

quotes.text:
I absolutely love this app, so on point, I dont even care about its aesthetic
because the readings are so spot on
but on my second day of paying for a full year subscription, the YES or NO Tarod Reading started to give only YES NO or MAYBE answers without any explanation as before

apps.title: Witch - AI Tarot Card Reading
apps.verdict: The daily card works as a ritual, readings can be accurate and sound like talking to a close friend, and for some it genuinely helps pull them out of a dark place. It breaks on almost everything being paid, ads for every bonus and minute-long unskippable videos, and since all readings are AI-based, some don't trust their sincerity and resent paying a machine.
apps.loved: The daily card as a ritual and mood support, accurate readings in a close-friend tone, help during depression and hard states, a good start for beginners
apps.weak: Almost all content paid, ads for every bonus and minute-long unskippable videos, all readings AI-based and some distrusting their sincerity, pricey subscription, canceling and refunds working poorly, readings sometimes getting the time of day wrong
apps.whoFor: For people who want a daily card ritual for mood support and are fine with readings being AI-generated

quotes.text:
I have been impressed every time I do a reading. The readings are so on point in every way reflecting on things about myself as if speaking with a very dear friend who knows me well while providing clarification for my better understanding and doing so in a clear and precise yet gentle manner.
As

This app has been a great resource for me. I have been suffering from depression for years and severe Bipolar Disorder episodes. This app and the daily card pull has really helped pull me out of that negative mindset. I actually look forward to my day and what it could bring because of the cards. Th

apps.title: Salvia - Tarot & Psychics
apps.verdict: This is a marketplace of live tarot readers and psychics, the best ones give detailed answers and real clarity, and people have favorite advisors they return to. It breaks on quality swinging from person to person, some giving generic answers or telling you what you want to hear, support ignoring messages and sending the same canned reply, prices that bite, and login sometimes failing with a network error.
apps.loved: Detailed answers from the best advisors, sense of clarity after a reading, favorite readers people return to, support in a hard moment
apps.weak: Quality swings sharply between advisors, generic answers and telling you what you want to hear, support unresponsive and sending templates, expensive, language barrier, crashes and network errors on login
apps.whoFor: For people who want to talk to a live tarot reader and are willing to hunt for their advisor by trial, not expecting even quality

apps.title: Yes No Tarot - Instant Answer
apps.verdict: The value is an instant yes-or-no when you cannot decide, and for people with decision fatigue it saves time before bed. Many honestly get that it is for fun, not prophecy, and simply enjoy the pretty decks. But the same question gives different answers, after an update a card gets stuck blocking the screen, and loud audio ads at night wake up the household even with sound off.
apps.loved: Instant yes-or-no answers, a time-saver for decision fatigue and ADHD, pretty decks including the Egyptian one, cheaper than seeing a psychic, clear card meanings
apps.weak: Different answers to the same question expose a generator, a stuck card blocks the screen after an update, loud night-time audio ads override even muted sound, only 3 decks, ads covering the reading
apps.whoFor: People who want a quick yes-or-no for fun and to unwind before bed, without believing in a literal prediction

quotes.text: To all the people saying this works, I believed you at first. It applied so much to what I was worrying about and it devastated me. Then I asked the same question multiple timed and it changed the answer, it even repeated one of the answers which means it was clearly a generator.

People with ADHD get decision fatigue really quickly so this is a huge time saver for when I'm being indecisive. The interface is clear, the different decks are very pretty interesting and the card explanations are insightful. I wish there was an ad-free version I could buy but the ads that do pop u

This isn’t what’s advertised. I expected clear cut yes or no but instead got a whole paragraph waxing poetic about something that had nothing to do with the question I asked.

I’m literally better off carrying my actual deck around than using this.

it’s decent for entertainment when you are trying to turn off the mind before bed. but I asked the same questions twice and picked a card at random. first round of questions were all no and in the 2nd round of same questions and picked from a different part of deck it was all yes.

apps.title: Fool’s Dog Tarot & Divination
apps.verdict: For years this was a favorite sampler deck: you could pull a card of the day from several decks at once and compare the symbolism, which helped people learn tarot and decide what to buy. An update cut it all back: two or three decks remain, cards lost their meanings on the back, the Celtic Cross is gone, and the reading journal crashes the app. People say it used to be the best and is now nearly useless and years without updates.
apps.loved: Pulling a card of the day from several decks at once to compare symbolism, a big variety of decks as a try-before-you-buy, meanings straight from the deck's booklet, helps learn tarot
apps.weak: An update removed the deck variety, card meanings on the back are gone, the Celtic Cross vanished, the reading journal crashes the app, years without updates
apps.whoFor: People learning tarot who want to try many decks in one place before buying, if they can accept the stripped-down post-update version

quotes.text: I love this app! It is easy to use. And so helpful. I use it to start my day! And it brings me focus on my purpose for the day.

This used to be a great app but now all the decks are gone. It only pulls from maybe 2-3 decks if you’re lucky and partially the same cards every other time 🙄 (and not in the typical tarot way). Features that were included since forever, are now $199?! A waste of time. This app also has some seriou

I’m exploring tarot and wound up purchasing a number of the Fool’s Dog apps. I got this sampler to get a feel for the different decks, but I’ve wound up using it for my Today’s Card drawing every day because it shows the card from four different decks! How great to be able to compare the symbolism f

apps.title: Tarot Card Meanings & Reading
apps.verdict: Beginners genuinely get help understanding tarot here, praising the quizzes, simple clear card meanings, and easy navigation. But almost everything useful sits behind a paid subscription, only the major arcana are free, and some people hit ads and confusion over what they paid for. Many expect card meanings free and would rather pay for spreads and courses.
apps.loved: Simple clear card meanings, quizzes for beginners, reversal meanings, easy navigation, responsive support with refunds
apps.weak: Almost everything locked behind subscription, only major arcana free, intrusive ads, confusion after paying for the yearly plan, payment went through without granting access
apps.whoFor: Tarot beginners learning card meanings from scratch who are willing to pay for spreads and courses

quotes.text:
This app is literally just what a beginner needs. Very easy to navigate and explain things in a way that is very easy to understand
Thank you!! Less is more

apps.title: Salvia - Tarot & Videncia
apps.verdict: This is a Spanish-language marketplace of live tarot readers, people have favorite masters like Ame Abal, replies come fast and help sort their thoughts. It breaks on credits being deducted even when no one answered the call, support staying silent and leaving messages on read, login sometimes failing, and different answers to the same question confusing people.
apps.loved: Live readers and favorite masters like Ame Abal, fast replies and clarity, help sorting your thoughts, simple ask-and-answer mechanic
apps.weak: Credits deducted when the call went unanswered, silent support leaving messages on read, login sometimes not working, different answers to the same question, few free questions
apps.whoFor: For Spanish speakers who want a live tarot reader and are ready to watch their credit charges and not count on support

apps.title: Daily Tarot Card & Astrology
apps.verdict: People use the single card of the day to set a mood and slowly learn the meanings, and beginners love it for that simplicity. But the product feels stuck: it looks dated, ads push in with music you can't mute, and some people see only '(null)' or bugs. One card a day feels thin, and many want three and ten card spreads.
apps.loved: Simple one card a day for beginners, helps learn meanings one card at a time, nice graphics, a sense of daily focus
apps.weak: Ads with music you can't turn off, dated look and old dates, bugs down to a blank '(null)', only one card a day, clumsy translation into other languages
apps.whoFor: Beginners to tarot who want a simple daily one-card ritual, not deep spreads

quotes.text: This app it’s kool, I give it 3 stars because it only has one tarot card for you , this app it doesn’t have different categories like 3 card tarots cads or 10 tarots card it only has the card of the day and I just wish this app had more to give

apps.title: Tarot Card Reading for Future
apps.verdict: People value the simple one-card yes/no draw with interpretation and that some readings resonate and land on personal topics. It breaks on being charged the yearly fee right after signing up for the trial with refunds denied, being required to follow them on TikTok for full access, heavy ads, and a new deck that's less detailed and far from classic tarot.
apps.loved: One-card yes/no draw with interpretation, sense of hits on personal topics, mini-games inside, broad reading sections on family work money love
apps.weak: Yearly subscription charged right after the trial starts and refunds denied, being required to follow on TikTok for access, heavy ads, the new deck less detailed and far from classic tarot, inconsistent accuracy
apps.whoFor: For people who want a fast one-card yes/no reading and are willing to watch their charges after the trial carefully

apps.title: Psychic Txt Live Tarot Reading
apps.verdict: The core value is a fast text answer within an hour plus the ability to pick a trusted advisor and come back to them for years, and people have favorites they believe in. But accounts get blocked for months with no way to unlock, paid credits and history vanish after updates, and support answers contradict each other or go silent. Some readers are openly rude, and text replies can take 7 or even 16 hours.
apps.loved: Fast text answer within an hour, trusted favorite advisors (Maria EC, Ginger, Sabrina, Daniela), honest readers who make no false promises, responsive support for some
apps.weak: Accounts blocked for months with no fix, lost paid credits and chat history after updates, contradictory support, waits up to 16 hours for a reply, rude readers, no refunds
apps.whoFor: People who want fast text guidance and will find one trusted advisor, accepting the account and billing risks

quotes.text: I’ve been a member of this app since 2024 and this platform has turned into a total scam. They are using fake, AI generated profile pictures and automated computer scripts for readings instead of real people. The readings use predatory scripts with trick questions at the end to force you to buy more

apps.title: Mystic Mondays
apps.verdict: The beautiful Grace Duong deck and a morning ritual with a card and a crystal keep people coming back for years, and some even bought the physical deck. But an update broke everything: a grey screen on launch, no way to log in because of a username check, an ad per card, and constant premium popups. Longtime fans are leaving and saying it got worse and harvests their data.
apps.loved: The bright, beautiful Grace Duong deck, the morning ritual with a card and crystal of the day, the daily card journal, thoughtful messages
apps.weak: Grey screen and won't open after the update, can't log in due to a username check, an ad per card, pushy premium popups, a flood of identical notifications
apps.whoFor: Fans of the Grace Duong deck and people who love a morning card-of-the-day ritual, if they can tolerate the breakage

quotes.text: The Mystic Mondays app is part of my daily morning routine I love kicking off my morning with a little daily message & guidance, & love grabbing the crystal I get in the card pull to have with me for the day (helps me reconnect with crystals & stones I otherwise would neglect & leave on a shelf some

I’ve been a tarot reader since 1998. My biggest problem with this app is the interpretation of the cards drawn. They’re often so negative and direct that they sound almost like a jealous frenemy and are boiled down far too simplistically for my tastes. It is also quite annoying that they go by the t

apps.title: Angel Answers Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People love keeping a favorite oracle deck right in their phone for quick guidance, and the old version was fast and handy with 5-card spreads. But after the update it crashes on the second card, some cards from the physical deck are missing, and instead of restoring a past purchase it asks you to pay again while pushing more buy-ons. Emailing a spread to a friend sometimes swaps a card to a random one.
apps.loved: A favorite deck always at hand, quick guidance, beautiful card art, a sense of accuracy for some
apps.weak: Crashes on the second card after the update, missing cards from the physical deck (26 instead of 44), being asked to pay for what was already bought, nagging buy-ons and ads, a card swapped when sharing with a friend
apps.whoFor: People who already own this physical deck and want to carry it in their phone for quick daily guidance

quotes.text: Physical deck has 44 cards, this app has 26 cards. Where’s the rest of the cards? The old app use to have them all. Can this be fixed please?

apps.title: Keen Psychic Reading & Tarot
apps.verdict: When you land on a good advisor, readings can be strikingly accurate and hit the personal, people name favorites and come back. It breaks on almost everything else, many advisors tell you what you want to hear and give contradictory answers to different people, billing is per-minute and charges a full minute for a couple seconds, advisors drop calls mid-session, and negative reviews get removed.
apps.loved: Strikingly accurate readings from the best advisors, hits on personal detail and comfort in grief, favorite advisors people return to, the tip to write questions down first
apps.weak: Advisors telling you what you want to hear to keep you coming back, contradictory answers across people, per-minute billing rounded up, advisors dropping calls mid-session, removal of negative reviews, technical failures in chat and calls
apps.whoFor: For people willing to carefully read advisor reviews and prep questions in advance so they don't burn money on empty readings

quotes.text: I recommend Shania, olu ogun, and the Lady lotus. I love them the most.
I asked 3 different people the same questions and got different answers from all of them. I also didn’t feel any physical connection to any of their “readings.”

apps.title: PsychicBook - Psychic Reading
apps.verdict: People come for a live advisor who names timeframes and gives clarity on their personal situation, and when a strong reader shows up (Clara Moonstone, Lawanda Shamani get named) it genuinely works. But the free-trial model is built to scare you about your closed energy and immediately sell a paid session, and some advisors reply in generic, slow ways that feel like a bot. Stock profile photos and different answers to the same question wreck the trust.
apps.loved: Accurate timeframes from strong advisors, clarity on personal situations, empathy from live readers, easy interface
apps.weak: Bot-like generic replies, the push for another paid session, stock profile photos, dragging out answers to eat paid time, leftover balance you cannot reuse
apps.whoFor: People who want a live paid advisor and will sift through readers for one accurate one, not those chasing free clarity

quotes.text: Talked to two “psychics” on here. I think this is AI or something. They could only do texts (red flag there). Very cold, uncaring, and just stated the obvious. Almost like a google search. Super unhelpful and disappointing.

apps.title: Beauty Everywhere Oracle Cards
apps.verdict: People like the idea of one place for dozens of oracle decks, call the cards artwork, and praise the free trials. But the app barely works: since iOS 17 it freezes constantly, purchased decks vanish and need restoring almost daily, and it keeps demanding updates. The tiny card-text window and a trial clock that starts at download rather than opening add to the annoyance.
apps.loved: All decks in one place, beautiful cards like artwork, free deck trials, daily readings when it works
apps.weak: Constant freezing since iOS 17, purchased decks vanish and need restoring daily, repeated update prompts, a tiny card-text window, trial clock starts at download
apps.whoFor: Collectors of many oracle decks who want them in one place, if they can bear constant freezing

quotes.text: I’d never been heard of an app before for oracle decks until friend shared this app with me. It’s been amazing to sample various decks without fully buying them. Totally recommend this app!!!

apps.title: Daily Tarot Card Reading Aura
apps.verdict: People like the app itself, some learned tarot solitaire, some find the advice accurate and blunt and true to the moment. But ads kill everything, videos pop even when you tap no free energy, you can't exit them, the page freezes after a video, and the free reading energy gets eaten anyway to push purchases.
apps.loved: Accurate unsweetened advice for the moment, learning tarot solitaire, pretty design, helps before major decisions
apps.weak: Flood of ads even after declining free energy, videos you can't exit, page freezing after an ad, free energy vanishing and pushing purchases, no back button in the spread
apps.whoFor: For people patient enough to push through the ads for a few accurate pieces of advice, or willing to pay upfront to remove them

apps.title: Angel Tarot Cards & Astrology
apps.verdict: The idea appeals to people wanting Christian angelic card-of-the-day guidance, and some feel supported and find it accurate. But ads pop up after every card flip, literally four in two minutes, so you cannot calmly finish even one reading. The cards do not match real tarot meanings and the text is written with errors, as if by a non-native speaker.
apps.loved: Christian angelic framing, card of the day for daily grounding, a sense of support and accuracy for some
apps.weak: An ad after every card (up to 4 in 2 minutes), cards that do not match real tarot meanings, error-filled broken English text, freezes and constant money prompts
apps.whoFor: People wanting Christian card-of-the-day guidance who can tolerate a barrage of ads

apps.title: Tarot card reading & meanings
apps.verdict: The concept draws people who want quick daily fortune-telling with meanings, and some find it accurate. But it charges for the card meanings from the very first spread, slips in a subscription up to 15.99 with no warning, and gives no way to cancel before the trial ends, so it bills you afterward. The English meanings are broken in places, and the tone can turn harsh and judgmental on a bad card.
apps.loved: Quick daily readings, a sense of accuracy for some, an interesting shuffle animation
apps.weak: Charging for card meanings from the first spread, a subscription up to 15.99 with no warning, no cancel before the trial and a charge afterward, broken English, a harsh judgmental tone on bad cards
apps.whoFor: Almost no one without a willingness to pay up front, only those wanting a very fast reading who do not mind the billing risk

apps.title: Tarot Numerology: Card Reading
apps.verdict: The idea of daily numerology and tarot with a personal reading appeals, and a few people say it hits accurately. But it demands payment for literally everything, there is no cancel button for the subscription, and charges go through without clear consent, flagged by bank alerts. On top of that the app will not let you set your birthday or zodiac correctly, so the reading breaks at its foundation.
apps.loved: A sense of an accurate personal reading for some, daily numerology and tarot
apps.weak: Payment required for absolutely everything, no cancel button for the subscription, charges without clear consent, birthday and zodiac set incorrectly, a short 3-day access then pay again
apps.whoFor: Almost no one, too many billing barriers and a broken birthday input undermine the whole point of the reading
